newsitem.title: USA: Boise Cascade Corp Q3 loss.
newsitem.headline: Boise Cascade Corp Q3 loss.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
(All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: Q2 1995 includes gain of $60 million or $0.98 per fully diluted share, from Boise Cascade Office Products Corp offering.
In 1995 Q3, Boise Cascade Office Products Corp issued 445,305 shares, resulting in gain of $6,160,000, or $0.10 per fully diluted share.
As of September 30, 1996, Boise Cascade Corp owned 81.2 percent of the outstanding Boise Cascade Office Products Corp common stock.
Stock prices reflect Boise Cascade Office Products Corp two-for-one stock split in May 1996.

In Q2 1995, the company established reserves for the writedown of certain assets in its paper and paper products segment to net realizable value with a pretax charge of $19 million, or $0.19 cents per fully diluted share after taxes. Company also added to its existing reserves $5 million before taxes, or $0.05 per fully diluted share after taxes, for environmental and other contingencies.

Net effect of gain on sale of Boise Cascade Office Products Corp stock, the tax provision for Rainy River, and establishment of above reserves increased net income $12.6 million and fully diluted earnings per share by $0.21 for 1995 nine month period.
